\label{lemma-cone-tor-amplitude}
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space.
Let $(K, L, M, f, g, h)$ be a distinguished

and $M$ has tor-amplitude in $[a, b]$, then
$K$ has tor-amplitude in $[a + 1, b + 1]$.
\end{enumerate}
